{"key":"req-0001","model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview","response":{"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview","candidates":[{"index":0,"citationMetadata":{"citationSources":[{"endIndex":315,"startIndex":7,"uri":"https://github.com/ChunxiaoIanLi/RL_reset","license":""}]},"finishReason":"STOP","content":{"parts":[{"text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nbool kissat_restarting (kissat *solver) {\n  assert (solver-\u003eunassigned);\n  if (!GET_OPTION (restart))\n    return false;\n  if (!solver-\u003elevel)\n    return false;\n  if (CONFLICTS \u003c solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts)\n    return false;\n\n  if (solver-\u003estable)\n    return kissat_reluctant_triggered (&solver-\u003ereluctant);\n\n  static float prev_fast_glue = 0.0f;\n  const double fast_glue = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n  const double slow_glue = AVERAGE (slow_glue);\n\n  const double velocity = fast_glue - prev_fast_glue;\n  prev_fast_glue = (float) fast_glue;\n\n  const double margin_factor = (100.0 + GET_OPTION (restartmargin)) / 100.0;\n  const bool trigger = (fast_glue \u003e slow_glue * margin_factor);\n\n  if (velocity \u003c -0.02)\n    return false;\n\n  if (velocity \u003e 0.05)\n    return true;\n\n  if (trigger)\n    return true;\n\n  if (velocity \u003e 0.0)\n    {\n      const double creeping_threshold = slow_glue * margin_factor * 0.90;\n      if (fast_glue \u003e creeping_threshold)\n        return true;\n    }\n\n  return false;\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e","thoughtSignature":""}],"role":"model"}}],"usageMetadata":{"totalTokenCount":11319,"thoughtsTokenCount":5052,"promptTokensDetails":[{"modality":"TEXT","tokenCount":5934}],"promptTokenCount":5934,"candidatesTokenCount":333},"responseId":"VNWKaYn4D4Saz7IPk8atwAY"}}
